Install a plugin from registry or URL

## Synopsis

```text
Install a plugin from the registry or directly from a GitHub URL.

Plugins can be specified in several formats:
  - Registry name: opencost
  - Registry name with version: opencost@v0.1.2
  - GitHub URL: github.com/owner/repo
  - GitHub URL with version: github.com/owner/repo@v1.0.0

Fallback Behavior:
  When a requested version exists but lacks compatible assets for your platform,
  the command can fall back to the latest stable version with compatible assets.

  - Interactive mode: You will be prompted to accept the fallback (default: No)
  - Non-interactive mode: Use --fallback-to-latest for automatic fallback
  - Strict mode: Use --no-fallback to disable fallback entirely
```

```text
finfocus plugin install <plugin> [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Install latest version from registry
  finfocus plugin install opencost

  # Install specific version from registry
  finfocus plugin install opencost@v0.1.2

  # Install from GitHub URL
  finfocus plugin install github.com/rshade/finfocus-plugin-aws-public

  # Install specific version from URL
  finfocus plugin install github.com/rshade/finfocus-plugin-aws-public@v0.1.0

  # Force reinstall even if already installed
  finfocus plugin install opencost --force

  # Install without saving to config
  finfocus plugin install opencost --no-save

  # Install and remove all other versions (cleanup disk space)
  finfocus plugin install opencost --clean

  # Auto-fallback to latest stable if requested version lacks assets (CI mode)
  finfocus plugin install opencost@v0.1.0 --fallback-to-latest

  # Fail immediately if requested version lacks assets (strict mode)
  finfocus plugin install opencost@v0.1.0 --no-fallback

  # Install with region metadata (selects region-specific binary)
  finfocus plugin install aws-public --metadata="region=us-west-2"
```

## Options

```text
      --clean[=true|false]                Remove other versions after successful install
      --fallback-to-latest[=true|false]   Automatically install latest stable version if requested version lacks assets
  -f, --force[=true|false]                Reinstall even if version already exists
  -h, --help[=true|false]                 help for install
      --metadata stringArray              Plugin metadata as key=value pairs (e.g., --metadata="region=us-west-2"); repeatable
      --no-fallback[=true|false]          Disable fallback behavior entirely (fail if requested version lacks assets)
      --no-save[=true|false]              Don't add plugin to config file
      --plugin-dir string                 Custom plugin directory (default: the configured plugin directory)
      --skip-checksum[=true|false]        Skip SHA256 checksum verification during installation (refused when FINFOCUS_SECURE_PLUGINS is on)
```
